$comment: Pickable scenery, by object name: what one pick gives and how the plant depletes. 'deplete' is the chance a pick removes it (or turns it into its 'empty' object), 'respawnTicks' how long until it is back, counted from the tick the pick starts (a number, or [min, max]). 'pickTicks' is how many ticks the item comes after the animation (default 1), 'startSound' plays the pick sound with the animation too. Sources per entry: 'capture' (rsprox), 'wiki', or 'estimated'.

pickables.name: Wheat
pickables.source: capture (Varrock wheat field: removed on every pick, back 20 ticks after the pick started)

pickables.name: Potato
pickables.source: capture (Lumbridge: back 50 ticks after the pick started); wiki: Potato (scenery), 50 ticks

pickables.name: Onion
pickables.source: wiki: Onion (scenery), respawn after 50 ticks; message unverified

pickables.name: Cabbage
pickables.source: wiki: Cabbage (scenery), respawn after 40 to 80 ticks depending on world population; message unverified

pickables.name: Sweetcorn
pickables.source: wiki: Sweetcorn (scenery), turns empty temporarily (its Empty 1/2 versions); respawn time estimated (as wheat); message unverified; the rare sweetcorn seed not modelled

pickables.name: Flax
pickables.source: wiki: Flax (plant), 3/16 chance to disappear, back after 10 ticks (Mod Ash)

pickables.name: Nettles
pickables.message: You pick a handful of nettles.
pickables.source: capture (rsprox recs 1001702, 1000376: sound 2581 with the animation, 2 ticks later the message, the nettles, sound 2581 again and the nettles removed; back 15 ticks after the pick started in 1001702); wiki: Nettles, gloves are needed (not Beekeeper's); without them no nettles and up to 2 damage, a green hitsplat but no poison. needsGloves: hands items named as gloves, gauntlets, vambraces or bracers, plus the Wiki's ==Gloves== list's other items (its only bracelet is the Regen bracelet), so bracelets, cuffs and armbands don't count
